title: Data Scientist / Data Engineer
description:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning - building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity - moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

What you'll do

  • Build auditable data pipelines for large clinical, diagnostic, and medical imaging datasets in the cloud.

  • Own statistical analysis across clinical studies, diagnostic performance, model evaluation, and data quality.

  • Apply classical machine learning and deep learning methods to data analysis problems.

  • Automated ontology induction from medical documents using large language models.

  • Build dashboards and data observability tooling.

  • Maintain strong data lineage, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility across data workflows.

  • Produce analyses and supporting evidence that hold up in regulatory submissions and audits.


What we're looking for

  • A master's degree or PhD in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, physics, economics or a related discipline

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or a closely related field, with demonstrated development of production-grade data solutions Proficiency in SQL and Python and software-development standards such as Git-based workflows, automated testing, code reviews and CI/CD

  • Comfort working with medical imaging formats including DICOM and NIfTI.

  • Practical experience with classical machine learning and explainable ML.

  • Working fluency with deep learning and modern LLM tooling.

  • Experience with cloud data infrastructure. We use GCP, but equivalent platforms are fine.

  • A strong working understanding of data lineage, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility.

  • Unusual attention to detail around data completeness, validity, consistency, and edge cases.

  • Flexibility at adapting to new technologies

  • Awareness of good software practices

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with medical imaging -clinical trials, pharmaceutical, healthcare or another regulated industry is an advantage 

  • Experience with knowledge graphs / temporal knowledge graphs 

  • Experience producing statistical analyses or technical evidence used in a regulatory submission.

  • Experience with model interpretability techniques such as SHAP.

Why Nucs AI

  • Mission with real impact  – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated.

  • Ground-floor opportunity  – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take.

  • World-class collaborators  – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.

  • Massive market tailwinds  – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.

  • Autonomy and flexibility  – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver.

  • Equity upside  – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

Equal Opportunity

Nucs AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Data Engineer Logistics
description:
Als Data Engineer word je onderdeel van het Data & Analytics-team in Rotterdam. Het grootste deel van je tijd werk je voor Business Unit Liquid Food, waar je functioneel en technisch mede-eigenaar bent van het datawarehouse en zorgt dat betrouwbare data beschikbaar is voor analyse en besluitvorming. Je combineert data engineering (back-end) met BI, en vertaalt businessvragen naar schaalbare oplossingen: van betrouwbare datastromen en semantische modellen tot dashboards, ad-hocanalyses en tender- en pricingtools.

Samen met je collega's moderniseer je het datalandschap, met volop ruimte om te experimenteren met predictive & generative AI, AI-agents, machine learning en procesautomatisering. Je standplaats is Rotterdam; om dicht bij de business te blijven werk je ongeveer eens per anderhalve week vanuit het kantoor van Liquid Food in Barneveld.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Het datadomein van Liquid Food beheer je: databasebeheer, architectuur, datamodellen, documentatie, datakwaliteit, continuïteit en doorontwikkeling;

  • Betrouwbare datapipelines ontwikkel en onderhoud je van bronsystemen naar het datawarehouse en de rapportageomgeving, voornamelijk met SQL;

  • Beschikbaarheid, volledigheid, juistheid en tijdigheid van data bewaak je, en structurele oorzaken van dataproblemen los je op;

  • Semantische modellen, dashboards en rapportages bouw je, en informatiebehoeften vertaal je naar heldere KPI's en self-service;

  • Aan businessgedreven projecten zoals tender-, pricing- en kostprijstools draag je bij, van concept tot beheer — zo sla je de brug tussen organisatie, processen en techniek;

  • Monitoring, logging, autorisaties en versiebeheer richt je in, met aansluiting op de centrale architectuur-, privacy-, security- en datagovernancekaders;

  • Kansen voor automatisering en voorspellende inzichten signaleer je, en continue verbetering stimuleer je via data- en procesanalyse.


Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je:

  • Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar, en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Ervaring hebt met SQL (3+ jaar), SSIS/SSDT, SSRS, SSAS en Power BI (semantische modellen en rapportage), plus dimensioneel modelleren en Data Vault-modellering;

  • Pré: Scrum, Microsoft Fabric, Python, Spark en Azure Data Factory;

  • Conceptueel denkt én praktisch handelt: je overziet architectuur en datastromen en vertaalt complexe vragen naar robuuste, werkende oplossingen;

  • Businessgericht, kritisch en verbindend bent, de taal van business én IT spreekt, en proactief eigenaarschap neemt;

  • Goed communiceert in Nederlands en Engels, in woord en geschrift.

  • Je bereidt bent om eens in de anderhalve week vanuit Barneveld te werken (must)!

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een passend salaris tussen € 3.651,- tot € 5.014,- bruto per maand, een laptop van de zaak, 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), 8% vakantiegeld, een feestdagengratificatie van € 550,- bruto, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Ruimte om te ondernemen: een uitdagende functie met veel zelfstandigheid, flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid, binnen een groeiende en informele organisatie met ambitieuze doelen;

  • Hybride werken vanuit Rotterdam, thuis en ongeveer eens per anderhalve week vanuit Barneveld (richtlijn bij fulltime: 3 dagen kantoor, 2 dagen thuis), inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding en flexibele werktijden;

  • Volop ruimte om te blijven ontwikkelen via de Den Hartogh Academy met meer dan 500 trainingen, e-learnings en webinars;

  • Oog voor elkaar: een fijne werksfeer met ruimte voor plezier, een inhouse gym en een caring- en vitaliteitsbudget.

Enthousiast?

Herken jij jezelf in deze rol en wil je het datalandschap van Liquid Food mee vormgeven? Solliciteer dan direct via de sollicitatiebutton. Nog vragen? Neem contact op met Angel Micheal Alemawor, interim corporate recruiter, via +31 6 11804991 of .

title: Data Analyst - Logistics
description:
Maybe you call yourself a Data Specialist, a BI Consultant, a "why-does-this-number-not-match-their-Excel" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam.

Whatever you call yourself: we're bringing a whole group of container terminals onto one data platform, and you will help us do that in the best way by getting to know how the container terminals work and how their data is shaped. Over time, you'll become the person everyone turns to when they need to understand a terminal and its data.

What you get 

  • A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience. 

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it. 

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months. 

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings. 

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop. 

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then. 

  • Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We will consider remote candidates too. We use salary zones, so the range may be lower elsewhere in Europe. If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands, the salary range will be shared before your first interview.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR. 

About us 

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. 

 
What the job looks like 

  • Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems.

  • Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team.

  • Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source.

  • Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal.

  • Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history.


What you bring 

  • Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told.

  • Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too.

  • Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job.

  • Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time.

  • Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge. You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards.

  • AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do.

  • Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus.

  • Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus.

  • Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.

 
We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

title: Data Engineer (tbv Productie & ESG)
description:
Heb je een passie voor data, technologie en duurzaamheid? ONE-Dyas is op zoek naar een Data Engineer om te zorgen voor de nauwkeurige verzameling, het beheer en de rapportage van productie-, koolwaterstof- en ESG-gegevens. Je zet complexe gegevens om in betrouwbare inzichten die operationele en zakelijke beslissingen ondersteunen.

Wat zijn je taken?

  • Het onderhouden en verbeteren van databases met gevalideerde productie- en ESG-gegevens.

  • Het verzamelen en integreren van gegevens uit productiebronnen en uit geëxploiteerde en niet-geëxploiteerde activa.

  • Het opstellen van duidelijke maand-, kwartaal- en jaarverslagen en visualisaties.

  • Het ondersteunen van de teams Production, Engineering, HSE en ESG met gegevens ter ondersteuning van operationele en zakelijke beslissingen.


  • HBO niveau in Techniek, Accountancy, Informatica, Milieuwetenschappen of een verwant vakgebied.

  • Ervaring met data-engineering of ESG-rapportage, bij voorkeur binnen de energie- of olie- en gasindustrie.

  • Kennis van databasebeheer, datavisualisatie en datagovernance.

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met Python, SQL of vergelijkbare tools.

  • Sterke communicatieve en probleemoplossende vaardigheden.

  • Een proactieve, zelfstandige en teamgerichte werkwijze met interesse in duurzaamheid.

  • In deze functie werk je tenminste 60% van je werkweek vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam.

  • Je kunt je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels.

Maak kennis met ONE-Dyas

ONE-Dyas B.V. is het grootste particuliere exploratie- en productiebedrijf in Nederland. Als onder-nemers in de Nederlandse offshore gas- en oliesector streeft het bedrijf ernaar een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de energietransitie, waarbij het vooroploopt op het gebied van duurzaam-heid en technologische innovatie. Het winnen van gas en olie dicht bij huis draagt bij aan de natio-nale economie, de voorzieningszekerheid en de klimaatdoelstellingen door gebruik te maken van lokale diensten, producten en knowhow, de afhankelijkheid van geïmporteerde brandstoffen te verminderen, de uitstoot te verlagen en te voldoen aan de hoogste milieunormen in de sector.

Met wortels die teruggaan tot 1893 in de mijnbouw, kent ONE-Dyas een lange geschiedenis van succesvolle baanbrekende energieoplossingen. Tegenwoordig bestrijken de activiteiten de volledi-ge levenscyclus van offshore-activa in Nederland, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk, waaronder het vlaggenschipproject N05-A in het Nederlandse en Duitse deel van de Noordzee, dat het eerste in zijn soort zal zijn waarin aardgas, windenergie en groene waterstof worden geïntegreerd. ONE-Dyas onderzoekt tevens actief mogelijkheden op het gebied van koolstofafvang en -opslag, en groene waterstof als toekomstige energieoplossingen.

ONE-Dyas, met het hoofdkantoor aan de Zuidas in Amsterdam en circa 150 medewerkers, kenmerkt zich door een sterke ondernemingscultuur, korte lijnen tussen alle disciplines en een hechte band met haar aandeelhouders, wat leidt tot een doelgerichte en effectieve werkomgeving. ONE-Dyas geniet in Nederland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Duitsland een uitstekende reputatie vanwege zijn ervaring en expertise in de gehele toeleveringsketen van de olie- en gasindustrie. ONE-Dyas staat erom bekend zaken veilig, betrouwbaar en efficiënt te realiseren.

Geïnteresseerd?

Wil je een bijdrage leveren aan betrouwbare productie en ESG-rapportage bij ONE-Dyas? Wij horen graag van je! Je kunt op deze functie solliciteren via het sollicitatieformulier (zie onderstaande link). Zorg ervoor dat je zowel je cv als motivatiebrief bij je sollicitatie uploadt.

Mocht je vragen hebben over de functie, neem dan contact op met Gerlof Visser (Hoofd Production Engineering & HCA):

Houd er rekening mee dat dit e-mailadres uitsluitend bedoeld is voor vragen over de functie. Sollicitaties worden alleen in behandeling genomen indien deze via het sollicitatieformulier worden ingediend.

title: AI Engineer — Federal Health IT
description:
AI Engineer — Federal Health IT
Location: Remote — United States
Security Requirement: Eligibility for a Tier 3 investigation

About the Role

Build AI-powered applications that help federal healthcare IT teams resolve issues faster, access trusted information, and deliver more effective technical support.

Rackner is seeking an AI Engineer to bring large language models (LLMs) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) into real-world service desk operations. In this hands-on engineering role, you'll create practical tools that enhance human decision-making while embedding security, reliability, and responsible AI practices.

What You'll Do

  • Build LLM-powered applications that streamline ticket triage and help service desk teams resolve technical issues more efficiently.
  • Develop RAG-based capabilities that make authorized enterprise knowledge easier to discover and use.
  • Evaluate and refine model-generated outputs to strengthen accuracy, relevance, and reliability.
  • Create workflows that enable AI to draft recommendations and suggest actions for human review before use.
  • Embed security controls, monitoring, and human oversight throughout AI-enabled applications.
  • Integrate intelligent automation into existing service desk processes using government-licensed or authorized tools.
  • Partner with technical and operational teams to advance responsible AI adoption while adhering to applicable federal AI governance requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience, including building applications using large language models (LLMs).
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and evaluating model output.
  • Eligibility for a Tier 3 investigation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the ServiceNow platform, including its AI capabilities.
  • Experience delivering AI solutions in federal or other regulated environments.

Why Rackner?

Apply your engineering expertise to meaningful federal healthcare IT challenges. At Rackner, you'll collaborate with technical and operational professionals, tackle real-world problems, and help translate emerging technologies into practical, secure applications while continuing to grow professionally.

Benefits & Perks

  • Company-supported certifications and professional development opportunities.
  • Career growth and leadership development opportunities.
  • 401(k) with 100% company match up to 6%.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Life and disability insurance.
  • Paid time off and paid holidays.
  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support.
  • Fitness and wellness reimbursement.
  • Weekly pay and team events.

Work Arrangement

This position is remote within the United States.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

As part of this role you will verify that business names and opening hours are correct. You will check that the distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately, resulting in better user experiences.

 

With this job you can plan your days around this highly flexible working schedule, work weekends or late evenings, all from the comfort of your own office. The flexibility of our roles minimizes the impact on your daily routine.

  • Develop your research skills.

  • Avoid the long commute.

  • Work from the comfort of your home office.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of setting your own working hours!

 

Ideal Candidate

  • Fluent in English and Japanese.

  • Excellent research skills.

  • Excellent local knowledge of your home country.

title: Compiler Engineer - Machine Learning Compiler
description:
About us

Mythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost. This unlocks bigger, more capable models and faster, more responsive applications—whether in edge devices like drones, robotics, and sensors, or in cloud and data center environments. Our technology powers everything from large language models and CNNs to advanced signal processing, and is engineered to operate from –40 °C to +125 °C, making it ideal for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and defense.

We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets.

About the role

Join us in building the next generation of AI compilers. You’ll play a key role in developing the compiler for our novel AI accelerator, working side-by-side with hardware engineers and ML researchers. Your work will shape how deep learning workloads run on cutting-edge dataflow hardware—defining the instruction set, execution model, and developer experience. The result: a compiler that delivers breakthrough performance while remaining seamless and intuitive for ML developers.

Here's what you will do

  • Contribute across the full compiler stack, including operator lowering, graph/IR transformations, optimization passes, and backend code generation
  • Optimize for dataflow architectures, developing pipelined schedules, memory orchestration, and resource-constrained execution strategies
  • Collaborate with hardware architects to influence architectural features, ensuring the compiler and hardware evolve together
  • Develop compilation strategies that unify our analog compute with digital subsystems
  • Build and maintain a compiler that produces high-performance binaries with strong debugging support, clear error messages, and predictable performance models

Here's the background we hope you will have

  • 3+ years of experience building compilers or high-performance systems software, especially those involving complex resource management or optimization.
  • Expert in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and strong Python.
  • Experience with compiler IRs (SSA-based or graph-based), transformations, and code generation
  • Exposure to specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) or parallel architectures

The following would be nice to have, but is not required

  • Experience with machine learning compiler stacks (e.g., ONNX, MLIR, TVM, XLA, IREE, PyTorch), with contributions to MLIR or LLVM projects a plus
  • Experience with optimization methods (LP/MIP, CP, SAT/SMT) using solvers like Gurobi or OR-Tools for scheduling and resource allocation
  • Experience compiling for specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) on DNN workloads; GPU/DSP experience is valuable if combined with compiler backend work beyond kernel tuning
  • Familiarity with heterogeneous compilation, especially mixing custom accelerators with CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, and exposure to analog or in-memory compute is a plus
  • Experience collaborating in compiler–hardware co-design (architecture + ISA) for better compiler usability and hardware efficiency

What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape how deep learning and LLM workloads are compiled on novel hardware.
  • A role that spans software and hardware co-design, shaping both the compiler and the accelerator architecture
  • A collaborative, innovative team that values engineering rigor, continuous integration, and user-focused design. We foster an environment of shared learning and technical excellence
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package

Compensation

Additional Information

At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. We hire smart, capable individuals, provide the tools and support they need, and trust them to deliver. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We value professionalism, creativity, and integrity, and strive to make Mythic a place where every employee feels they belong and can contribute meaningfully.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (x/f/m) - Medical Software
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

Alan runs its own care provider, and Clinic Platform is the software behind it.

  • Today: members get care directly in the Alan app. Our AI health assistant answers first, then our own doctors take over through chat and video consultations, with a secure medical record.

  • Why it matters: it's the foundation of Alan's care. In 2027, we'll scale it across France, launch it in Belgium, Spain, Canada and more to come, and open it to new health services built on top of it.

  • What you'd build: the platform doctors and members rely on every day: video consultations, scheduling, medical records and tools that save doctors time, all secure by design.

  • The team: small, with the scope of a startup. Each engineer owns a critical part end to end, with AI in the product and in how we build.

Your impact:

  • 🩺 Build with doctors: ship the tools our doctors use every day, designed with them.

  • 🤖 AI-powered care: connect our AI health assistant to every care service, so each consultation starts with full context.

  • 🌎 Go international: build one platform that each new country and health service can configure, not rebuild.

  • 🔒 Secure by design: shape how medical data is stored and shared safely, in line with healthcare regulations.

You'll influence the product direction, mentor other engineers and lead technical initiatives (more in this article).

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You're the perfect fit if you:

  • Think product first: you start from the user's problem, a doctor or a patient, not from the stack.

  • Work across the stack: deep in one area, at ease across frontend and backend. We use TypeScript and Python. You don't need to know both.

  • Own what you ship: you've built and run a product with real users, and you care about reliability.

  • Learn fast: AI tools are part of how you work.

  • Are fluent in English. French is a plus: part of our work is with French doctors and French healthcare rules.

We hire from mid-level to staff engineers. The most senior will own the platform's foundations: medical data storage, security and how the platform evolves.

What makes you stand out

  • Healthtech experience: you've built digital health or medical software.

  • React Native: our members live on mobile.

⭐ The Engineering team ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is React, Python/Flask, PostgreSQL in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.

Want to know more? Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article on our Engineering career path.


🌍 How we work

Location: You must be legally eligible to work in France

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor pages for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

🔄 A quick note about the process
Note: While you're applying for a specific area, you may join a different engineering team based on where we think you'll have the most impact. Check out descriptions of other areas here.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex.

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • Have two roles:

  • admin:

    • Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”.

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Build at least two n8n workflows:

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”.

Deliverables

  • A GitHub repository with the app source code.

  • Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository.

  • A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions.

  • A short note on what you would change to run this in production.

We evaluate:

  • Code structure and clarity

  • Security-minded thinking

  • UX and practicality

  • Integration design, reliability, and error handling (n8n)

  • Documentation and reasoning

Interview Process

  1. Take-home assignment submission (as described above).

  2. Technical & product interview (walkthrough of your solution, architecture, security mindset, collaboration style).

  3. 6-month contract offer for the right candidate, with strong potential for renewal as a recurring contract based on performance and ownership.

How to apply

Email your portfolio, GitHub repository, and as an optional bonus, 1-2 other relevant projects to techjobs@fluencetraining.com, along with a short note on a security/privacy consideration you implemented (or would implement) in a healthcare or similar context.

description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Software Engineer - Global Memberships Platform

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers growth at a global scale for all three of our brands: Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.

Our team, Global Membership Platform, owns the core platform capabilities that drive the subscription model, which is key to our business. We build and run the shared services behind how customers join, manage and benefit from our membership offerings, giving every brand a single, reliable and scalable foundation to launch and evolve its membership proposition. Because membership is a paid product, we work closely with the Money team on payments, from how members are charged and billed to how payment outcomes feed back into their membership, so correctness and reliability are central to what we build. As a new team, we have a clear mandate and plenty of room to shape it: designing platform services that work across brands and regions, keeping a business-critical, always-on system dependable, and partnering with engineers, product and design teams across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt to bring membership together as one global platform.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our London team. In this role, you'll help us build and maintain high-performance systems that power our global marketplace, ensuring a seamless experience for millions of users. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a multi-disciplinary engineering team focused on technical execution and collaboration. As a Software Engineer at Deliveroo, your individual work contributes to achieving goals across your team, simplifying the maintenance of production systems while ensuring operational readiness and health.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Technical Excellence: Improve code structure and architecture across your team's remit, developing, releasing and running large-scale web applications whilst transitioning our monolithic codebase to a microservice-based architecture

  • Lead Project Planning: Foresee dependencies and risks, partnering closely with Product and Design to ensure smooth delivery of complex features, whilst defining the backend architecture and tech stack for a product area

  • Optimise Operations:Improve performance, reliability, scalability and security for our backend systems

  • Collaborate & Influence: Build relationships across global engineering teams to identify collaboration opportunities and influence the wider technical roadmap.

  • Mentor & Hire: Support the personal growth of your colleagues through technical guidance and take an active role in conducting engineering interviews to scale our team.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software 
  • Strong Engineering Principles: Deep pride in writing readable, well-designed, and well-tested software.

  • Backend Expertise: Significant experience building web-based applications (we use Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, and Rust).

  • Data Proficiency: Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and "NoSQL" backends like Redis, DynamoDB, or ElasticSearch.

  • Systems at Scale: Proven ability to manage web architecture at scale (handling 20krpm and above).

  • Technical Leadership: Experience breaking down large pieces of work and guiding implementation choices for a team of engineers.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

title: Software Engineer | Mid-Office | Python
description:
BlockTech is hiring a Software Engineer to join its Mid-Office team in Amsterdam.

Positions, PnL, and hedging all run through Mid-Office. When a number our traders or risk team rely on is wrong, this is where it gets found and fixed.

In this role, you'll build and run that platform, and you'll be the one who follows a wrong number until you know why.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

The Mid-Office team owns the systems that keep positions, PnL, and hedging correct across every venue we trade. We work in Python, with Grafana and PostgreSQL alongside.

What will you do?

You will build and own the systems that keep our books and data accurate, including the quantitative work behind them. You'll be responsible for spotting discrepancies, investigating unexpected numbers, and tracing issues to their root cause.

You will:

  • Own the books. Maintain and evolve our position, trade, and PnL systems so they stay accurate across every venue.

  • Do the quant work. Build and refine our hedging, Greeks, margin models, and early exercise premium calculations.

  • Surface the risk. Build the risk views and calculations that show traders and the risk team what exposure we're carrying.

  • Support the desk. Work side by side with traders and researchers, and make sure the data they rely on is correct and available.

  • Deliver reporting. Provide the data internal stakeholders and regulators need: PnL breakdowns, trade surveillance, treasury accounting, and compliance.

  • Own it in production. Spot discrepancies in live data, trace the root cause, and maintain what you ship.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • You'll need to be an engineer at heart, with a strong quantitative background and a genuine passion for building and improving systems.

  • A relevant educational background, ideally in a quantitative field such as mathematics, econometrics, or computer science.

  • Professional experience with Python, Grafana, and PostgreSQL.

  • Strong debugging skills. You can trace problems to their source, even in unfamiliar systems.

  • A critical mind that follows problems through to completion, high ownership, and clear communication in English.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in finance, ideally trading, on the systems behind positions, PnL, risk, and hedging.

Pay, location, and relocation

  • Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results.

  • Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

  • Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office

  • Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

  • Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% tax ruling.

What else is in it for you

  • Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

  • Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

  • Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

You'll be challenged and stretched in this role, with plenty of room to grow within and beyond your main responsibilities. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Ready to own the numbers the desk trades on?

Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days.

Our culture

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

title: Software Engineer, Agent
description:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

What you’ll do

  • Design and deliver production-grade AI agents: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes—they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.

  • Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

  • Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

  • Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.

Example projects

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

  • Design and build AI agents for large telecommunications and media companies that consistently outperform human agents in managing subscription churn

  • Develop and refine AI agents capable of navigating complex customer interactions, like troubleshooting a broken device and personalising product recommendations

  • Create generalisable AI agent frameworks tailored for industry-specific use cases. See some examples in our financial services blog!

  • Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development

  • Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

  • A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship

  • Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems

  • Excellent communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

  • Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

  • Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

  • Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

  • Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders

Our values

  • Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

  • Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

  • Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

  • Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at ----- Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Threat Research Engineer, youâll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. Youâll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster.

What youâll do

  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs.

title: Acquisition Operations
description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.

We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

The mission

Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand.

Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets.

You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet.

Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet.

 

What you'll build

Horizon 1: Master the engine (first 90 days)

  • Own the numbers: run the weekly read of the acquisition funnel (spend, leads, qualified sellers, booked calls, expected margin per call) vs plan. Explain every gap down to its root cause and drive the actions that close it.

  • Make the data trustworthy: build the single source of truth with our Data team, set the counting and attribution rules, and own the conversion signals we send to Meta, Google and every new platform, including how we count and value bookings made by our AI sales agent as it takes over the qualification call.

  • Find the first levers: landing pages, keyword quality, creative performance, base activation, new channels. Ship fast, measure honestly.

Horizon 2: Automate the loop (months 3 to 9)

  • Agents that see: automated monitoring, anomaly detection and daily variance diagnosis, so problems are caught in hours, not weeks.

  • Agents that decide: explicit, testable rules and models for budget allocation, creative cut and scale, bidding signals and activation timing.

  • Agents that act: campaign changes, CRM activations and experiments executed automatically within guardrails, with humans approving what matters.

Horizon 3: Scale the autopilot (9 months and beyond)

  • Close the loop between creative, media, CRM and our AI sales agent, so every learning flows back into every channel.

  • Run experimentation on autopilot: hypotheses generated, tests launched, results read and rolled out continuously.

  • Define the operating model of a growth team where agents do the execution and people do the thinking, and grow the team that runs it.

 

Why this role

  • Impact you can measure in euros: every decision you make moves expected margin, and you'll see it within days.

  • Build, don't advise: you'll ship agents, models and automations, not recommendations. You get frontier AI tools, our data platform and engineers who build with you.

  • Direct line to leadership: you'll present growth performance every week and shape decisions at company level.

  • A rare combination: strategy, data, marketing and AI engineering in a single seat. The steepest learning curve we can offer.

  • A path that grows with the system: from operator to architect to leader of growth automation at Zefir.

 

Who you are

  • Top-tier problem solver: 2 to 6 years at a top strategy consultancy (BCG, McKinsey, Bain...), in Growth, Ops or Strategy at a high-growth tech company, or both. You structure messy problems in minutes and you get the math right the first time.

  • Builder at heart: you have already built something real: a model, a tool, an automation, an AI agent, a side project. SQL is second nature; Python is a strong plus. You'd rather prototype in an afternoon than debate for a week.

  • Commercial instinct: you think in revenue, not in vanity metrics. You're curious about why people click, book and buy, and you know when fewer leads is good news.

  • Systems thinker: when you see a task done twice, you design the system that removes it. You care about guardrails, feedback loops and what happens when things break.

  • Ownership and clarity: you hold a high bar, move fast and own outcomes. You write crisp updates that start with the number, the cause and the action.

  • Languages: fluency in French and English is required.

  • What we don't require: years of media buying or a marketing title. We hire for slope, not intercept: if you learn fast and build relentlessly, we'll teach you the rest.

 

Hiring process

  • 30-min call with our Talent Lead

  • 30-min interview with the hiring manager

  • 60-min live case on real (anonymised) funnel data. AI is allowed in part of the case: we want to see how you use it.

  • 15-min coffee chat with our RevOps lead and 45-min Behavioral interview with our CoFounder, then references


Benefits

The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term..), please, check with your recruiter.

  • Competitive salary: You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator.

  • BSPCE (Stock Options): Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period.

  • Healthcare plan: Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

  • Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement): With flexible remote work options.

  • Swile meal card: €11 per worked day.

  • Swile mobility card: €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

  • Team events: Monthly Mixers to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.

🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

Application & Process

We welcome applications from anyone, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, or experience. Our team values authenticity and diverse perspectives.

For all roles, our interview process emphasizes hands-on exercises, case studies, or discussions about specific examples of your previous work. We ensure objectives and expectations are clearly communicated at every step.

We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill.

Location: Paris (Hybrid)

  • Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products.

  • Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together.

  • Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter.

  • Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients

  • Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly.

  • Core (ML): Algorithms, models, data systems

  • Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, or a related field.

  • Comfortable coding in at least one: Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript.

  • Passionate about AI, data, or building meaningful product features.

  • Curious, collaborative, and excited to learn.

  • Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow.

Nice-to-Haves (but not required)

  • Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems.

  • Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing.

You’ll see us on campus at:

  • Télécom Paris

  • Forum Trium

  • ENSIMAG

  • CentraleSupélec

  • École Polytechnique

  • EPFL

  • Forum Organisation

Meet us there and tell us what excites you.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

Dein Profil

Fachlich

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Generative AI, Machine Learning oder intelligenten Automatisierungslösungen sowie mit modernen Cloud- und Integrationsarchitekturen.

title: Test & Development Engineer
description:
Halo is a technology company building the future of haircare for all textures through exceptional engineering and human-centered design. We create category-defining products built for the complexities others overlook.

We're building HaloBraid, the world’s first braid assist device. It helps stylists finish braids 5 times faster, flawlessly and gently. This is one of the hardest unsolved problems in robotics, applied to a $270B salon services industry, and integrating computer vision, compliant fiber manipulation, and novel mechanisms.

Billions of hours are spent braiding hair each year. HaloBraid gives that time back. We’re moving from R&D into deployment with salons and manufacturing, and backed by leading investors.

Responsibilities:

  • Independently develop and execute test plans to validate mechanical, electrical, and electromechanical systems against product requirements.

  • Design, build, and commission custom test rigs, fixtures, and automated test setups.

  • Develop test procedures for performance, reliability, durability, and failure testing.

  • Identify failure modes, investigate root causes, and work with engineers to implement and verify design improvements.

  • Develop test automation, data acquisition, and analysis tools to improve testing efficiency and repeatability.

  • Establish robust testing processes, documentation, and reporting to support engineering development and design validation.

  • Support quality assurance and quality control, including developing inspection procedures, acceptance criteria, and production test methods.

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, software, and manufacturing engineers to improve product reliability and readiness for production.

     

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in test engineering, product validation, or a related engineering discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience independently designing and building mechanical or electromechanical test rigs.

  • Strong hands-on mechanical and electrical engineering skills, including sensors, actuators, instrumentation, and data acquisition.

  • Experience developing test plans, defining acceptance criteria, and translating engineering requirements into measurable tests.

  • Proficiency with Python or similar tools for test automation and data analysis.

  • Experience with reliability testing, failure analysis, and systematic troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with QA/QC principles, measurement repeatability, and engineering documentation.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced R&D environment with evolving designs and incomplete specifications.

  • Strong engineering judgement, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently.

     

Desired Skills & Experience (optional but the more, the better)

  • Experience testing robotics, consumer electronics, or complex electromechanical products.

  • Experience with design verification testing (DVT), environmental testing, accelerated life testing, and production validation.

  • Familiarity with CAD, machining, 3D printing, and rapid prototyping.

  • Experience with manufacturing quality processes, FMEA, statistical analysis, and end-of-line testing.

  • Experience with hardware products going from prototype through production.

  • Regulatory, compliance, and certification experience

Benefits of Working with Us:

  • We offer a competitive salary, 28 days holiday + bank holidays and a range of other benefits.

 

Onsite Work

This is an onsite position in the UK at the Paintworks in Bristol's creative quarter.

This position closes on December 7th 2026 for review.

 

Don’t Meet Every Requirement?

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align with every single part of the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.
