title: Forward Deployed Engineer - DevOps/SRE
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, highly technical and customer-centric Forward Deployed Engineer - DevOps/SRE to join our Customer Success team. In this role, you will play a crucial role as a technical solution expert and advisor working closely with some of the largest Harness AppSec customers to design, implement and optimize Harness platform and adoption strategies to ensure they realize maximum value and outcomes.

Our team is small, collaborative, and deeply motivated — we work at the intersection of technology, security, and business, and we bring curiosity and rigor to a wide range of challenges. You will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a rapidly growing company while helping customers harness the power of our AI-enabled DevSecOps platform to build and deliver software securely and efficiently — including protecting AI applications from emerging threats.

We prioritize psychological safety, mentorship, and continuous learning. Whether you're coming from engineering, architecture, consulting, or security — we want to hear from you.

About the role

  • Serve as the primary technical owner of customer implementations and adoption programs across the Harness AppSec portfolio, developing deep familiarity with each customer's environment, goals, and success criteria
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance and consulting to customers throughout the customer lifecycle, from onboarding and implementation to adoption and value realization.
  • Develop strategic account success plans to ensure successful operationalization and value realization and drive alignment with all levels of customer leadership.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Harness platform and AppSec modules as well as general skillset across AI applications and security, DevOps, SecOps, application security, cloud architectures, networks and infrastructure disciplines and industry trends to effectively support, educate and advise customers.
  • Proactively analyze customer usage data to surface trends, adoption gaps, and optimization opportunities — delivering actionable recommendations across technology, process, and people dimensions.
  • Bring constructive feedback from customers to product management to improve the solution, and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, and engineering, to drive the successful adoption, integration, and ongoing optimization of our solution.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and check-ins with customers to ensure their ongoing success and satisfaction, addressing any concerns or issues in a timely and effective manner.
  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts by performing churn and adoption analysis to ensure target product adoption and business (AGRR) goals are met.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of customer success processes, tools, and resources to continuously improve the efficiency and effectiveness of our customer success delivery methodologies and collateral.
  • Participate in Harness Community forums and help build reference architectures, best-practice guides, and enablement content

About you

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, security engineering, or technical account management within the software or technology industry.
  • 5+ years of experience with some multiple of the following solutions preferred:
    • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure, Terraform, CloudFormation, Linux
    • Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, OpenShift, PCF
    • CI/CD & DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Harness Pipelines, Jira, ServiceNow.
    • Languages & Scripting: Python, Bash, YAML, Go (a plus).
    • Application Security: SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST, SBOM generation, API security testing, pen testing fundamentals, SIEM (Splunk, Datadog), SOAR platforms.
  • Prior experience in security engineering and architecture, application security, API and AI security, development, DevOps, SecOps, or web security is preferred.
  • Ability to quickly learn, understand, and work with new emerging technologies and solutions in the AI, DevOps, Cloud and Security space.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to manage complex customer relationships and communicate business and technical value to all levels of management.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues.
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and growth.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, such as Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering is preferred

Must Have Skills

  • Kubernetes eco system expertise (k8s, helm, release, upgrade, troubleshooting etc)
  • In depth Cloud experience - AWS is a must (GCP, Azure good to have) - infra provisioning, VPC++ ,EKS, S3, EBS ,EFS, EC2 etc
  • Linux ecosystem
  • Troubleshooting skills for the above
  • Programming (Scripting) experience along with ability to write custom integrations or tailored

Pay transparency

$180,000—$202,000 USD

Harness in the news:

  • Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
  • Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
  • Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
  • Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

description:
JoinphData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.

We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.

Why phData?

  • Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year
  • AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
  • 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)
  • 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status
  • 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year
  • Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network
  • #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications
  • 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)
  • Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM

Why Join phData Solutions Engineering

At phData, the Solutions Engineering team is where ambitious builders meet consultative advisors to turn modern data ideas into measurable business value. You’ll shape strategy with executives, whiteboard with architects, and stay close through delivery to ensure outcomes land. Your impact shows up in customer wins, revenue growth, and real-world analytics and AI/ML outcomes.

What’s in it for you:

  • Work end-to-end across the modern data lifecycle—platforms, pipelines, governance, analytics, and AI—on cloud-native tech like Snowflake, AWS, and Anthropic.
  • Grow your career in multiple directions: principal technologist, sales engineering leader, or solutions strategy (SOW and value engineering).

About the Solutions Engineering Team

We partner with customers and cross-functional phData experts to design the right solution, clearly show business value, and guide successful execution. We’re hands-on and consultative: we prototype, de-risk, and stay close post-sale to ensure customer success.

Location Focus: This role has a strong preference for candidates based in the Central US or Eastern US (Atlanta metro or Northeast corridor) to align with our client footprint and enable easy travel for key in-person meetings.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years as a Solutions Architect with experience architecting, building, and supporting modern data platforms
  • Prior technical presales experience with strong technical skills, business acumen, and a sales mindset.
  • Experience establishing and growing accounts, including building trusted relationships, cross-selling services, and developing business case proposals.

  • Strong working knowledge of SQL with the ability to write, debug, and optimize distributed SQL queries.

  • Excellent communication skills with stakeholders and customers.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
This is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales Teams.

Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.

What your day will look like

  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers’ business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional skills of interest

  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
description:
Role Description

As anÂ Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Teamâs tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropboxâs offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

  • Automatisierte Bereitstellung und Konfiguration von Systemumgebungen auf Basis von Infrastructure-as-Code (u. a. unter Einsatz von Terraform, Terragrunt oder Ansible)

title: Technology Consultant - AI Visibility (w/m/d)
description:
Du hast in einer Beratung Technik und Business zusammengebracht und Kunden bis in die Umsetzung begleitet. Jetzt machst du das für das, was nach der klassischen Suche kommt.

Du weißt, dass eine Strategie erst zählt, wenn sie beim Kunden läuft. Und du siehst, dass die Antwort immer öfter direkt in ChatGPT, Perplexity oder den AI Overviews steht. Für Marken zählt deshalb, ob sie dort als Quelle auftauchen.

scaile - AI Visibility for Enterprise - ist der GEO Execution Layer. Wir recherchieren, schreiben, veröffentlichen und optimieren kontinuierlich den Content, mit dem Marken in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini und Perplexity gefunden und zitiert werden. Unterstützt von TUM Venture Labs und NCA VC, in Forschungspartnerschaft mit der TUM, sind wir bereits live mit Kunden wie UniCredit, Axel Springer, Beurer, Lyceum Technologies und 50 weiteren Unternehmen.

Wir wachsen gerade stark und wollen unser Customer Facing Team ausbauen. Als Technology Consultant bist du die Ansprechperson unserer Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass diese Ergebnisse kommen.

Du gehst mit deinen Kunden eine neue Frage an: Welche Quellen ziehen LLMs heran, und warum zitieren sie eine Marke? Die Antworten findest du in Daten und Experimenten und setzt sie gemeinsam mit dem Kunden um. Die Tools dafür baust du dir mit Claude Code oder Codex selbst.

Aufgaben

  • Kundenprojekte: Du bist die Ansprechperson und verantwortest die AI Visibility für ein eigenes Kundenportfolio, vom Kickoff-Workshop, bis hin zur Strategie und zur technischen Implementierung beim Kunden.

  • Strategie: Du analysierst, welche Quellen LLMs zitieren und warum. Daraus leitest du Content-Cluster, Briefings und Prioritäten für unsere Content Engine ab und rollst sie beim Kunden aus, bis die Maßnahmen live sind.

  • Implementierung beim Kunden: Du bringst die technische Basis beim Kunden zum Laufen. Du setzt die Anbindung an die Systeme des Kunden um und entwirfst die Content Pipeline.

  • Automatisierung: Mit Claude Code oder Codex baust du dir Audits, Datenabzüge, Auswertungen und kleine interne Tools selbst.

  • Reporting: Du zeigst Kunden im wöchentlichen Termin, was sich bewegt, von Klicks und CTR bis zu Zitationen in AI Search, und leitest klare nächste Schritte ab.

  • Experimente: Du testest, was in AI Search funktioniert, hältst Inhalte aktuell und bringst Learnings mit Product und Engineering ins Produkt.

Dein Erfolg ist messbar: wie viel mehr Conversion wurde durch die Sichtbarkeit in der KI Suche erzielt.

Qualifikation

  • 1-2 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Consultant in einer Beratung oder einer Digitalagentur, idealerweise in technischen Transformations- oder Implementierungsprojekten.

  • Du hast eigene Kundenprojekte verantwortet und verbindest Technik und Business: Du übersetzt zwischen Fachbereich, IT und Entwicklung des Kunden und bringst Lösungen bis in die Umsetzung.

  • Du arbeitest agil und lernst schnell, auch in einem Feld, das es so noch nicht lange gibt.

  • Du bist vertraut mit Claude Code oder Codex und hast damit schon Skripte, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut.

  • Du willst verstehen, wie LLMs Quellen auswählen, und testest das lieber selbst, als darüber zu lesen.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, führst Workshops und trittst vor Enterprise-Kunden sicher auf, auch gegenüber deren IT und Entwicklung.

  • Low ego, high ownership - dir ist wichtiger, dass es richtig ist, als recht zu haben.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und sehr gutes Englisch, in Wort und Schrift.

  • Gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland.

Nice to have: Python- oder SQL-Grundlagen, erste Berührung mit AEO/GEO oder Prompt Tracking, Erfahrung mit Google Search Console oder SEO-Tools wie Sistrix und Ahrefs.

Benefits

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt.

  • Echte Ownership: deine Kunden, deine Ergebnisse.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern, flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege.

  • Ein Feld, das gerade entsteht: AI Search. Du lernst es nicht aus Blogposts, du prägst mit, wie es gemacht wird.

  • Nah an der Forschung durch unsere Partnerschaft mit der TUM.

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents

  • Dinner ab 20:00

  • Urbansportsclub

  • Drinks, Snacks und Kaffee

  • Uber nach 22:00

  • Büro mitten in München/Hamburg, Team von 11+ Leuten.

title: Werkstudent:in Software & KI
description:
Über die Position

Als Werkstudent:in entwickelst du zentrale Softwarekomponenten für ein Unternehmen, das wir gerade aufbauen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem wissenschaftlichen Team zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Methoden in verlässliche Software. Dabei gestaltest du mit, wie wir Daten verarbeiten, Analysen durchführen und KI dort einsetzen, wo sie fachlich einen Mehrwert liefert.

Du begleitest deine Lösungen von der ersten Umsetzung bis in den produktiven Betrieb. Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt, wie zuverlässig und nachvollziehbar die Ergebnisse unseres Produkts sind.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Wissenschaftliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit dem Team konkretisieren und in Datenpipelines, Analyse-Workflows und APIs umsetzen.
  • KI-Anwendungen entwickeln, geeignete Modelle und Werkzeuge auswählen und ihre Ergebnisse systematisch evaluieren.
  • Software produktionsreif machen und betreiben. Dazu gehören automatisierte Tests, ein sauberer Umgang mit Fehlerfällen und Monitoring.
  • Technische Entscheidungen mitgestalten, damit wir die Software mit neuen Daten und Methoden zuverlässig weiterentwickeln können.

Dein Profil

  • Du studierst Informatik, Data Science, Bioinformatik oder ein vergleichbares Fach und programmierst sicher in Python und dem terminal.
  • Du hast bereits eine KI-Anwendung selbst umgesetzt und kannst erklären, wie du ihre Ergebnisse geprüft, Fehlerfälle behandelt und die Anwendung für den Einsatz vorbereitet hast.

title: Deployment Engineer
description:
Flink Robotics is a fast-paced startup backed by world-class VCs, originating from the Computational Robotics Lab at ETH Zurich. We’re building the next generation of plug-and-play robots, powered by a novel approach to make robots autonomous. Our robots are designed to revolutionize material handling, from stacking boxes to sorting parcels and unloading goods.

We’re looking for a hands-on Deployment Engineer who loves debugging, stress-testing and is ready to install robots that move the world’s parcels. In this role, you’ll be the face of Flink at customer sites and industry events, making sure every system is rigorously tested, commissioned and continuously improved.

Who you are

  • Eager to join a VC-backed startup in its early phase and take ownership of field projects.

  • Passionate about robotics: from mechanics and electronics to computer vision and control.

  • Proactive problem-solver wanting to learn new things

  • Clear communicator, fluent in English, German, French, and other languages is a strong plus.

  • Excited about frequent travel to production sites (up to 60 %).

  • Enjoys collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and customers on the shop floor.

What you bring

  • Mechanical engineering background with experience designing, prototyping, and building mechanical assemblies

  • Ability to diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues, with an understanding of mechatronics, sensors, networking and basic control principles

  • Demonstrated track record in commissioning complex electromechanical or robotic systems in the field

  • Excited about travel and deploying robots in production environments

  • Prior robot deployments, proficiency in German or other languages, driver's license and familiarity with Linux are a plus

What you'll do

  • Assemble, configure and test our robots in the lab and at customer sites to iterate and improve the system

  • Plan, coordinate and execute on-site installations, acting as the technical lead and ensuring a smooth handover to the customer

  • Design, prototype, and produce mechanical and electrical elements for new product run deployments

  • Train operators and provide hands-on support during ramp-up, collecting insights that feed straight back into our product roadmap

  • Diagnose and resolve complex hardware/software issues, both remotely and on-site

Why join

  • A great team dedicated to building a product with almost unlimited potential

  • Work on challenging problems at the cutting edge of robotics

  • Competitive salary, equity, and top-tier gear

  • Work in a central office in Zurich and around the world, wherever our partners are

Apply now if you’re ready to push boundaries and help shape the future of robotics!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers.

Tasks

  • Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use

  • Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely

  • Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards

  • Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems

  • Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team

Requirements

  • Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language

  • You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site

  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through

  • Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German

  • Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria and valid driving licence (category B)

Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously.

Benefits

  • Early team member with real ownership – your work ships to paying customers, not a demo

  • Employee stock options: you own part of what you build

  • New office in Zürich Kreis 5

  • Modern, AI-first toolchain – we invest in whatever makes you faster

  • Work directly with the founders

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

This Associate role is responsible for providing Finance Recon and Pre Pay Support to ensure claims are paid accurately and with the highest quality. This is accomplished by leveraging a deep understanding of Oscar's claim infrastructure, workflows, workflow tooling, platform logic, and data models to work cross-functionally to understand and translate friction from stakeholders into actionable opportunities for improvement. The Associate takes ownership of complex operational delegations to transition maintenance tasks away from leadership, securing bandwidth for multi-million dollar network optimization.

You will report into the Senior Manager, Payment Integrity.

Work Location: This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in Atlanta, Georgia; Chicago, Illinois; Louisville, Kentucky; Minneapolis, Minnesota; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania; Dallas,Â Texas; Salt Lake City, Utah. While your daily work will be completed from your home office, occasional travel may be required for team meetings and company events. #LI-RemoteÂ

title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About Augment

Logistics is broken. Let's fix it.

We are a team of engineers, product designers, and customer champions building Augie, Augment's AI teammate for supply chain. Augie reasons and acts like a seasoned operator, automating the busywork of quoting, dispatch, tracking, billing, and more for freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors.

Our team has scaled billion-dollar companies, built delightful products, and powered billions in commerce. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and want to define how AI reshapes supply chain, apply today.

Overview

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps team. You'll own our deal desk, support territory planning, and run the reporting our sales leaders rely on every week as we grow from 12 AEs to more than 20. You'll also keep our data clean and handle the day-to-day work behind forecasting, quota administration, and commission calculations. This role reports to the Director of Revenue Operations.

Our GTM Motion

Our motion is outbound-led. SDRs prospect and qualify freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors before AEs run discovery and close. We sell across Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Strategic segments, with six-figure ARR deals and buying committees that span operations, IT, and finance. Your deal desk and reporting work needs to hold up to that complexity.

What You'll Do

  • Own the deal desk: review pricing, discounts, and non-standard terms, route approvals, and make sure every closed deal is booked correctly

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, and Legal so quotes and contracts move fast without surprises

  • Support territory planning: model coverage and capacity, manage account assignments, and keep regions and segments up to date as we roll them out, starting with Distribution

  • Own sales reporting: run the weekly forecast and pipeline reports leadership uses to call the quarter, and build dashboards for pipeline, conversion, bookings, and AE and SDR performance

  • Report contracted ARR and live, billing ARR side by side, and work with Finance so the numbers tie out

  • Keep HubSpot clean and reliable: own data quality, required fields, account ownership, and deal hygiene

  • Calculate commissions and support quota tracking, working with the Director and Finance

  • Help onboard new hires to our sales tools and processes, and document how things work

What We're Looking For

  • 2 to 4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Deal Desk at a B2B SaaS company

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting a deal desk, including pricing approvals and contract review

  • Experience supporting territory planning or account assignment

  • Hands-on CRM admin experience. We're on HubSpot, and experience there is a strong plus

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and comfort with SQL or a BI tool

  • A detail person who cares when the numbers don't match and digs in until they do

  • Clear communication with sales leaders and reps, including pushing back when the data says otherwise

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in logistics, freight, trucking, distribution, or supply chain tech

  • Experience administering commission plans or quota models

  • Familiarity with Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Seamless.ai, Clay, or BI platforms

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive Salary + Stock Options

  • Comprehensive Health, Vision, and Dental Benefits

  • Flexible PTO

  • Monthly stipend

About Augment

At Augment, we set out to create a fully autonomous AI platform that streamlines operations and reclaims the human element in logistics. Our founders recognized a pattern: talented professionals were stuck handling manual data entry, phone calls, and repetitive tasks, instead of focusing on high-impact problem-solving and strategic decision-making.

That insight became our missionâto free logistics professionals from busywork so they can focus on what truly drives business growth. Augment isnât just about efficiency; itâs about transforming an entire industry by empowering teams with AI-driven solutions that make logistics smarter, faster, and more adaptive.

Join us on this journey!

Augment is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity at our company. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Augment complies with federal, state, and local laws regarding equal employment opportunity and reasonable accommodation. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact your recruiter.

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000+ people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 8 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. Team

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to scale any product we build. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech.

Today, our Creative team makes 10K+ ads a month, mostly by hand. We are rebuilding that process with AI to multiply both our output and our hit rate. The challenge is to build tools that produce at massive scale, with quality that holds up.

Role

You build the AI tools that let our creative team scale ads production without losing what makes them great. title: Sr People Partner
description:
Vantage is growing, and we need a Sr People Partner to help our leaders become great ones. Your core client group is engineering managers, along with new managers and team leads across the business. Your job is to build a culture where coaching drives performance and where people feel it in their day-to-day experience at Vantage. You model the leadership you coach. You give managers candid advice, earn trust through sound judgment and follow-through, and hold leaders accountable for how they lead.

This is a hands-on business partner role. You’ll coach managers through difficult conversations, run performance cycles that focus on growth as much as evaluation and handle employee relations from first concern to resolution. You will lead projects that shape how we define and measure great work and use onboarding, exit interviews and people data to keep improving the employee experience. You’ll also advise on employment compliance across Canada, the US and the UK, support compensation planning, and help build fair, consistently applied policies.

Key Responsibilities

Business Partnering & Manager Coaching

  • Be the primary people partner for employees, people leaders and team leads across the business.

  • Equip managers to drive high performance through clear goals, ongoing feedback and real accountability, so great work gets recognized and issues get fixed early.

  • Build manager habits that drive a culture of performance: setting clear goals, coaching in the moment, recognizing top performers, and acting quickly when performance slips.

  • Advise on and manage employee relations matters, including performance improvement plans, written warnings, and terminations.

  • Help design and launch a leadership training program for new and developing managers.

Performance Management

  • Run the 90-day and Annual Review processes for your client groups, from manager preparation through to follow-up.

  • Help define our competencies and what great work looks like at Vantage, and build them into how we measure performance.

  • Build career planning frameworks that give employees a clear view of how they can grow here.

  • Own ER cases from first concern to resolution, including investigations into harassment and misconduct complaints.

  • Manage accommodations and leaves across jurisdictions with our Payroll and Benefits Specialist.

  • Escalate and partner with the Head of People on higher-risk matters.

Programs, Policy & Compliance

  • Refine People reporting so leaders have the data they need to make decisions.

  • Create company content that explains our people programs, policies, and changes.

  • Own the multi-jurisdiction handbook and support policy rollouts and manager training.

  • Prepare offer, promotion and merit recommendations using market data and our compensation philosophy.

  • Advise on employment standards across Ontario, BC, Alberta, the US (including California) and the UK through our EOR.

Employee Experience

  • Own and improve onboarding and exit interviews to improve the employee experience and lifecycle.

  • Support company events and initiatives, including in-person days, recruiting events, company retreats, and employee resource groups.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 5 to 7 years of experience in an HR Business Partner role.

  • Experience at a scaling SaaS or technology company including experience partnering with engineering teams.

  • Hands-on ER experience, including investigations, PIPs and terminations.

  • Strong knowledge of performance management, competency frameworks.

  • Sound judgment, discretion with confidential information, and the confidence to give leaders direct coaching and feedback.

  • Ontario employment law knowledge; US/California exposure is an asset.

  • Experience with comp planning or pay equity.

  • Nice to have: PEO/EOR experience and CHRP/CHRL are assets.

About Vantage
Vantage is the first unified platform purpose-built for retail media orchestration, empowering enterprise retailers to seamlessly activate onsite, offsite, and in-store advertising. With a global presence in North America and Asia-Pacific, Vantage enables retailers to launch and grow their media networks through scalable technology and automated workflows, and is trusted by leading retailers like The Home Depot to power their retail media programs.

For a closer look at what we do, our culture, and our benefits, check out our about us and careers pages.

Remote-First, Based in Toronto
Vantage is proudly headquartered in Toronto, but we’re a remote-first team spread across North America (and beyond). Our flexible work philosophy means team members can thrive from wherever they do their best work—whether that’s from a home office, a local café, or while adding stamps to their passport. With a remote-friendly setup, home office support, and annual company retreats, we stay connected, collaborative, and energized—no matter the time zone.

Vantage’s Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Vantage Analytics is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment. We encourage all individuals to apply for positions that fit their passions.

We promote equality and strive to provide all current and prospective employees with support and opportunities. Reasonable accommodations are available to job applicants on request and throughout the application process.

How Vantage Uses AI in the Recruitment Process

At Vantage, we use AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. This may include using AI to help organize, screen, and assess applications. We are committed to using these tools responsibly, and ensuring every candidate is treated fairly throughout the process.

All hiring decisions at Vantage are made by our team. Who we invite to work at Vantage is a decision we only trust ourselves to make.

What's Next?
We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of the final stages of our hiring process, all candidates will be required to successfully complete a criminal background check.

- Review pairs of e-commerce listings and decide whether they are the same product and the same sellable variant, returning ACCEPT or REJECT.

- At native proficiency level of Korean.

- Able to read product titles, specifications, and text within images.

- Familiarity with e-commerce product data (SKUs, variants, bundles, gifts, capacity and quantity notation). Experience in merchandising, data annotation, or content moderation is a plus.

- Strong attention to detail, especially on subtle differences like model suffixes, volume, color, and count.

- Ability to apply rules consistently and document the reasoning.

- Proficiency with Excel/CSV.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets â including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review â as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. The Opportunity ð

As Corporate Counsel, Commercial, you will be the legal partner behind Carrotâs customer and vendor contracts. Day to day, you will negotiate, draft, and review a high volume of commercial agreements, including master services agreements, service level agreements, professional services agreements, and NDAs. You will partner closely with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions quickly, manage most matters from start to finish, and escalate high-risk issues when the moment calls for it.

  • Manage a high volume of contracts at all times while protecting quality and turnaround speed.
  • Support privacy and data protection terms in commercial agreements, including HIPAA Business Associate Agreements and Data Protection Agreements.
  • Work across a complex, global matrix of collaborators to support Carrotâs growth.
  • Use contract lifecycle management and AI tools to improve the efficiency of legal research, drafting, and contract workflows.

  • Improved contract workflows by making full use of Ironclad and AI-enabled tools.




About You â¨

You likely have:

  • A J.D. and membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 3+ years of legal experience, in-house and/or at a law firm, ideally with in-house transactional experience at a health plan or startup.
  • A strong grasp of contracting concepts and solid experience drafting, negotiating, and interpreting commercial and vendor agreements such as MSAs, SLAs, professional services agreements, and NDAs.
  • Experience counseling a sales organization.
  • The ability to analyze and advise on legal and regulatory risk, with creative solutions that support growth.
  • Flexibility, a willingness to work on a broad variety of legal matters, and comfort with ambiguity.
  • A record of strategic thinking and of working across a complex matrix of global collaborators, pairing strong legal analysis with practical business recommendations.

Â 

Nice to Have â­

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts with global companies.
  • Experience with complex multi-party commercial agreements and vendor agreement review.
  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle management software, especially Ironclad.

  • Knowledge of the employee benefits, healthcare, and/or pharmaceutical industries.

Â

Carrotâs contracts are how our mission reaches people. Every agreement with an employer, health plan, or health system shapes how well members around the world can access fertility and family-building care. In this role, you help Carrot say yes to growth in ways that protect the company, our customers, and the members we serve.

Because you will own most matters from beginning to end, your judgment directly affects deal velocity, customer trust, and revenue. You will be a visible, trusted partner to Sales and the broader business while helping a rapidly growing global company scale its commercial legal function.

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen â 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview â 30â45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews â 45 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

description:
Our Mission

Healthie is an AI-Native, ONC Certified EHR for modern outpatient healthcare.Â 

Healthie is proud to power clinically excellent healthcare for over 40,000 providers who deliver clinically excellent healthcare - longitudinal and collaboratively, with patient and provider experiences at the center. About the role

Weâre hiring a Customer Success Manager to join our Private Practice Enablement team and help customers get the most out of Healthie throughout their entire journey with us. Youâll work with private practices and growing healthcare organizationsâsome brand new to Healthie, others who have been with us for years.

Details, details

  • Weâre seeking fluent English speakers/writers.
  • The salary range is $93,000 - $102,500

About you

And it is a requirement that you've worked at a software company. Bonus points if youâve worked in healthcare technology, or have experience working with private practices or growing healthcare organizations.

  • Youâre comfortable independently leading customer conversations and building relationships with everyone from individual providers to practice managers and healthcare leaders. You ask thoughtful questions, listen closely, and know how to adapt your approach to the person in front of you.
  • Youâre a natural educator and an excellent communicator. You can take complicated products, workflows, and questions and turn them into clear, practical next steps. We value good writers.
  • Youâre curious about how customers work. You want to understand what someone is actually trying to accomplish before recommending a solution, and you enjoy learning the different ways healthcare organizations operate and deliver care.
  • Youâre a strong problem-solver with good judgment. When there isnât an obvious answer, youâre comfortable researching, testing different approaches, and using the resources around you to figure out the best path forward.
  • Youâre organized and self-directed. You can manage customer calls, emails, follow-ups, and projects simultaneously, take ownership of whatâs in front of you, and recognize when something needs another perspective or team.
  • Youâre good at navigating challenging conversations. You can set expectations, explain limitations, and provide thoughtful guidance even when the answer isnât exactly what a customer hoped to hear.
  • You have plenty of tech skills, and you're confident working across a variety of tools and apps, and can troubleshoot everyday issues on your ownâthings like browser quirks, connectivity problems, login hiccups, and mobile device settings.
  • Youâre a collaborative teammate and strong customer advocate. You share what youâre learning, give helpful and direct feedback, and bring patterns from customer conversations back to the broader team so we can continue improving how we support our customers and build Healthie.

How to applyÂ 

Please submit a PDF cover letter and introduce yourself. Include:

  • Tell us who you are and why you want this job at Healthie.
  • Where are you based and what time zone are you in?
  • Why do you want to work in Customer Success?

In your cover letter, answer these real-world customer scenarios. Reply to the customer directly like you would if you worked on our Private Practice team. Also tell us how youâd approach the conversation, and explain your thinking for each reply.Â 

  • A customer recently signed up for Healthie and is excited to get started. They want to go live as soon as possible and have an upcoming appointment with a client. They need help manually adding the client to Healthie and sending them an invitation to access the platform.

Interview Process

  • Interview with Talita, Private Practice Team Lead (30 minutes)
  • Interview with Justin, VP of Customer Support (30 minutes)
  • Live demo with Talita and Jen (30 minutes)
    • Youâll be asked to give us a brief product demo. Youâll share your screen and show us how to add a client and schedule an appointment.Â 
  • Final session with Talita and Justin (30 minutes)
  • Reference checks

Healthie is subject to HIPAA and other security and privacy frameworks, and this job entails training and conformance to expectations regarding security and compliance.

Healthie participates in e-verify.

Healthie is committed to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to and will not be discriminated against based on age, race, gender, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability or any other protected category. title: Founding Account Executive – Italy
description:
About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

  • ~110 people on the team in Munich

  • €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You open Italy for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on.

Why this role exists

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Italy is one of our expansion markets. It has a broad industrial base, from automotive suppliers to machinery and food production, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Italy from there.

Why your role matters

  • A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

  • You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

  • You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Italy.

  • You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

  • Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

  • Not a remote role: You build Italy from our Munich office and travel into the market.

Your tasks

  • Open up Italy end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Spanish manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

  • Run the full sales cycle: Discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case and closing.

  • Build the outbound playbook: Hand in hand with the expansion team, you develop messaging, sequences, segments and channels for your market.

  • Turn marketing into pipeline: You coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline.

  • Shape our international expansion: You feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Track record: You’ve carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • Value selling: You grasp complex products and translate technical depth into business impact

  • Languages: Fluent, business-level English and Italian. German is a strong plus

  • Location: Based in Munich or ready to relocate

Core strengths

  • Entrepreneurial: You want to build and own a market result, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn’t exist yet

  • Hunter: You go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline

  • Builder: You turn what works into a system the next person can run

  • Thinks beyond the next deal: You lay Tacto’s foundation in your market, externally through brand, network and reference logos, internally through the playbook and the case for the market

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • €1,500+ learning budget per year

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you’d be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Werkstudent:in Bioinformatik - Mikrobiom
description:
Über die Position

Als Werkstudent:in entwickelst du die bioinformatische Auswertung für ein Mikrobiom-Unternehmen, das wir gerade aufbauen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem wissenschaftlichen und technischen Team zusammen und überführst metagenomische Methoden in reproduzierbare Analysen, die wir im Produkt einsetzen können. Deine Arbeit trägt direkt dazu bei, wie verlässlich wir Mikrobiomdaten auswerten und wie gut sich die Ergebnisse nachvollziehen lassen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Metagenomische Sequenzierungsdaten auswerten, von der Qualitätskontrolle bis zur taxonomischen und funktionellen Profilierung.

  • Analysewerkzeuge und Referenzdatenbanken vergleichen und gemeinsam mit dem Team entscheiden, welche Methoden für unsere Fragestellungen geeignet sind.

  • Bioinformatische Pipelines implementieren, testen und dokumentieren, damit sie sich mit neuen Datensätzen zuverlässig ausführen lassen.

  • Analyseergebnisse gemeinsam mit dem wissenschaftlichen Team einordnen und methodische Grenzen sichtbar machen.

Dein Profil

  • Du bist in einem Masterstudiengang in Bioinformatik, Computational Biology oder einem verwandten Fach eingeschrieben.

  • Du hast bereits selbst metagenomische Sequenzierungsdaten ausgewertet, zum Beispiel in einem Forschungsprojekt, einer Abschlussarbeit oder einem Praktikum. Erfahrung mit Shotgun-Metagenomik ist besonders relevant.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Linux und der Kommandozeile und setzt bioinformatische Analysen in Python um.

  • Du kannst erklären, warum du eine Analysemethode gewählt hast, wie du ihre Ergebnisse überprüfst und wo ihre Grenzen liegen.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und kannst technische und wissenschaftliche Themen auf Englisch besprechen und dokumentieren.

  • Erfahrung mit Workflow-Tools wie Nextflow oder Snakemake sowie mit dem Betrieb von Anwendungen oder Pipelines auf AWS ist ein Plus.

Wenn du die bioinformatische Grundlage eines entstehenden Mikrobiom-Unternehmens mit aufbauen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Unser stetiger Anspruch ist es, unseren Kunden in Planung und Beratung Lösungen in höchster Qualität zu liefern. Nachhaltig, effizient, vertrauensvoll.

Wir sind Teil der Natural-Power-Gruppe, einem internationalen Ingenieursdienstleister im Bereich der Erneuerbaren Energien mit weiteren Niederlassungen in UK, Irland, Frankreich, Italien und den USA.

Über diese Position

Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams im Bereich Netzanschluss suchen wir für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit einen engagierte*n Werkstudent*in (16-20 Wochenstunden), dem die Energiewende ein echtes Anliegen ist.

Deine Aufgaben


  • Bearbeitung von Netzanschlussanfragen für PV-, Wind- und Speicheranlagen
  • Aufbereitung und Import von Netzdaten sowie deren Modellierung in PowerFactory
  • Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Schaltplänen mit AutoCAD
  • Aufbereitung von Daten und Erstellung detailreicher Karten mithilfe von QGIS
  • Unterstützung des Teams bei vielfältigen Themen rund um den Netzanschluss

  • Idealerweise fortgeschrittenes Bachelorstudium oder Beginn des Masterstudiums. Alternativ eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung mit praktischer Erfahrung im Bereich Elektrotechnik oder Energietechnik
  • Erste Kenntnisse in der Netzmodellierung, idealerweise mit PowerFactory (DIgSILENT), sind von Vorteil
  • Interesse an der Programmierung sowie idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit Python, VBA oder DPL oder die Bereitschaft, diese Kenntnisse weiter auszubauen
