title: Business Development Representative - German Speaking
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the role

As a core member of our Sales team, you’ll connect with a wide range of prospects and spark their interest in our authentication tech. You’ll be on the front lines of our growth engine, partnering with AEs and other BDRs to uncover opportunities, start meaningful conversations, fuel a steady pipeline of qualified leads, and own the full lifecycle for smaller deals.

What you'll do

As a Business Development Representative, you’ll focus on getting companies excited about our product. You’ll be reaching out to prospects across every level - from procurement managers and lead engineers to heads of anti-fraud, platform owners, CTOs, CPOs, and even CEOs. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Generating new sales opportunities for Prelude

  • Identifying companies and people to target within your verticals/territories

  • Cold calling and emailing as well as experimenting with other channels to find new leads

  • Qualifying leads and pitching Prelude's value proposition

  • Closing smaller deals independently

  • Maintaining a clean CRM

  • Improving processes as we scale our business

About you:

  • You have 6 months to 1 year of BDR or sales experience, ideally selling a technical product at a startup, scale-up, or SaaS company

  • You can handle the friction and challenges of cold calling and outbound prospecting

  • Solid understanding of qualification fundamentals

  • Able to understand technical concepts and translate them into business terms

  • A proactive mindset, with a drive to start conversations, build momentum, and close deals

  • Structured and rigorous in managing your pipeline, CRM hygiene, and performance metrics

  • You know your way around HubSpot, Sales Navigator, Apollo, RingOver, or Kaspr

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, taking initiative and finding solutions

  • Strong interpersonal skills and an excellent team player

  • Curious, coachable, and eager to learn by doing

  • Fluency in selling a technical product in German

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package (base + uncapped commission)

  • Comprehensive health insurance plan

  • Urban Sports Club gym membership

  • 100% transport subsidised

  • Swile meal vouchers

  • Pet-friendly office environment

  • Free snacks and drinks in the office

  • Laptop and equipment needed to do the role

  • Hybrid working style: 4 days at the office and 1 day at home, with 4 weeks of remote working per year

  • An annual offsite in a great location (last one was at Le Pradet)

Interview process

  • Call with recruiter

  • Call with a Sales team member

  • Case study

  • A visit to our offices to meet the team and interview with our CEO

We don't expect you to ace all these stages - we will evaluate your creativity and how you approach difficult problems. You should consider applying even if you don't meet all the criteria; we'll carefully review all of the applications we receive.

Compensation: €57K

  • • OTE €57K

OHana Entreprise est une société de développement de logiciels et d'applications web et mobiles qui accompagne ses clients en France et en Afrique avec des solutions numériques sur mesure. Notre mission est de répondre aux besoins spécifiques de nos clients en leur fournissant des solutions technologiques de qualité au sein d'une équipe internationale.

Vos missions

Vous interviendrez sur des projets de développement complets pour concevoir, développer et maintenir des applications web et mobiles performantes.

  • Développer et maintenir des applications web en utilisant React pour le front-end et Node.js pour le back-end.

  • Créer et optimiser des applications mobiles en utilisant Flutter.

  • Collaborer avec l'équipe de conception pour transformer les maquettes en fonctionnalités fonctionnelles et intuitives.

Profil recherché

Vous maîtrisez Node.js, React et Flutter. Ce poste de freelance s'adresse aux développeurs rigoureux souhaitant s'investir sur un contrat de 12 mois à raison de 40 heures par semaine dans le cadre d'une collaboration à distance.

Avantages

Profitez de conditions de travail flexibles incluant le télétravail et le travail à distance.

Vos premiers mois chez OHana Entreprise

Dès votre arrivée, vous prendrez part activement au développement des applications de nos clients en mobilisant vos compétences sur React, Node.js et Flutter. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec l'équipe internationale pour livrer des fonctionnalités sur mesure répondant aux exigences techniques des projets en cours. Vous aurez ainsi rapidement contribué à la concrétisation des solutions technologiques que nous déployons.

-

title: Finance Controller
description:
Finance Controller

Location: Netherlands

Start date: Q1 2027

Compensation: €70k - €80k annually (depending on experience)

Employment type: Full-time (contractor if outside Netherlands)

About DTACT

DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data.

As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most.

The Role

We are looking for a Finance Controller to own DTACT’s finance function end-to-end as we continue to scale internationally. Reporting into the COO, you’ll take full ownership of accounting, collections, financial analytics, budgeting, and compliance (including our Dutch statutory obligations) — acting as the single point of accountability for finance in the business today. This is a hands-on, mid-level role: you’ll be expected to run the entire finance function largely on your own in the near term, while also bringing the leadership mindset and ambition to grow the function — and your own role — as DTACT expands.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end accounting operations — AP/AR, general ledger, and month end/year-end close — ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting.

  • Manage the full collections process: invoicing, aging follow-up, and cash flow forecasting.

  • Build and maintain finance analytics (dashboards, reports) that give leadership clear, real-time visibility into company performance.

  • Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle, partnering with department leads to track actuals against plan.

  • Ensure full compliance with Dutch tax and statutory reporting requirements (VAT, annual accounts) and manage relationships with external accountants, auditors, banks, and tax advisors.

  • Partner with People Operations on payroll processing and accuracy across jurisdictions, and own administration of the employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).

  • Build and continuously improve finance processes, technical efficiencies and controls, laying the groundwork as the company grows.

What you'll bring

  • 5–8 years of progressive finance/accounting experience, including hands-on ownership of a full finance function — ideally within tech in a startup or scale-up environment.

  • Solid knowledge of Dutch accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory compliance requirements and payroll.

  • Proven ability to independently manage accounting, collections, budgeting, and financial analytics without a large supporting team.

  • Strong analytical skills and financial modeling ability; comfortable turning data into clear, actionable insights.

  • Leadership potential and genuine ambition to grow into a finance leadership role as the team and company scale.

  • A hands-on, “roll up your sleeves” attitude, paired with the ability to think and plan strategically.

  • Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch.

What's in for you

  • Competitive compensation and equity participation, including an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing you to share in DTACT's long-term success.

  • Remote-first flexibility, with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs.

  • A trust-based culture built around asynchronous communication, empowering people to work independently while staying connected and aligned across teams.

  • Generous time off, including vacation days and local public holidays to help you rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Home office support, including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace.

  • An international and diverse team, where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives.

  • High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats.

We believe diverse teams build better solutions.

DTACT welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity. We hire based on skills, experience, and potential, and encourage everyone who meets the role requirements to apply.

Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence.

description:
Responsibilities

- Review annotators’ ACCEPT/REJECT decisions and reject reason codes, with a focus on preventing false matches and false rejects.

- Sample-check or fully review high-risk rows (multiple codes, OTHERS, rows with uncertainty notes).

- Correct errors, give feedback to annotators, and identify recurring error patterns to keep rule interpretation consistent.

- Compile questions for the client where rules are ambiguous, and maintain a clarification log.

- Validate structural compliance of deliverables: every input row returned exactly once and unchanged, timestamps, exact decision and code spelling, correct separators, valid CSV, identifiers preserved as text.

- Track and report accuracy, review coverage, known limitations, and unresolved rows to support the summary report.

- Monitor progress to ensure on-time delivery.

Requirements

- At native proficiency level of Korean.

- 1+ years of experience in data annotation, content moderation, or QA; team lead or training experience preferred.

- Strong judgment on edge cases, with the ability to explain decisions clearly.

- Clear communication and the ability to give constructive feedback.

Nice to have

- Experience building evaluation sets, analyzing accuracy, or managing annotation quality.

- Understanding of AI-assisted annotation workflows and associated risk controls.

VPN and Location Verification: What You Need to Know

1. Application and onboarding: no VPN. Please do not use a VPN when you apply or go through onboarding.

2. Production: VPN required. Once production starts, you will need to use a VPN. Opera browser is recommended. (Opera is a free built-in VPN and needs no extra installation.) We will send you setup instructions before production begins.

3. Which VPNs are allowed. Standard consumer VPNs are fine. High-risk proxies are not permitted.

4. Periodic checks in Production. For administrative reasons, we may occasionally ask you to access AI Trainer platform without your VPN so we can check your unmasked IP.

title: Localization Quoting Specialist
description:
About Welo Life Sciences

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com

Main Purpose of the Job

The Localization Quoting Specialist is responsible for assessing the scope of each project and completing project quotes. They communicate as needed with the Project Management team to ensure client requests are met in a timely manner, while supporting the project completion process through the development and use of language tools and pilot processes

Responsibilities

  • Prepares quotes and calculates turnaround times for clients (administrative management).
  • Responsible for conducting a follow-up of quotes in order to achieve the target acceptance rate.
  • Monitors client satisfaction and any increases/decreases in their use of services.
  • Provides feedback on perceived client satisfaction and service completion.
  • Detects new sales opportunities bringing add-on business and retaining existing accounts.
  • Discusses and plans sales strategies for existing clients with the Business Developers.
  • Advises the client on how to best manage a project, not only in terms of product specifications but also with regard to expenses.
  • Tries to reduce administrative tasks by implementing sales actions to improve workflows with existing clients and increase margins.
  • Responsible for meeting targets in the following KPIs: the amount of money quoted, amount of money accepted and price-per-project of existing clients.
  • Communicating project information to necessary parties in a clear, concise and professional manner.
  • Conveying specific client requests effectively to Project managers.
  • Finance governance: Responsible of registering the correct information from de clients when creating the projects in the system: Legal entities (from the client and Welocalize), PO if needed, billing schedule.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Essential: Fluent in English, excellent oral and written communication, and comfortable speaking to clients at all levels, via phone or video call.
  • Desirable: Knowledge of other language Essential: Total Command of Microsoft Office.
  • Desirable: Knowledge of XTM and/or Phrase, and FineReader.

Education and Experience

  • Education:
  • Essential: Middle or higher-level vocational training in administration or university degree.
  • Desirable: Master's Degree.
  • Experience: 2-4 years of experience in customer-facing activities related to the localization/translation/project management fields.

Compensation

Additional Information

Welocalize is committed to equal opportunities and in compliance with the General Law on the Rights of People with Disabilities, this vacancy is also available and we encourage to those candidates who have a disability certificate (equal to or greater than 33%) to apply.

title: Account Executive, Field Sales
description:
About Fin

Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin.

About the Role

We’re hiring an Account Executive to win early customers in the luxury goods / watch dealer market, plus closely related high value, high trust SMB verticals. This is a field-first, relationship-driven role. You will spend a meaningful chunk of time traveling to meet customers in person, build trust quickly, and close.

This is a founder-adjacent role on a small, collaborative team. You will help shape the playbook as we move fast in a competitive landscape.

What You’ll Do

  • Own new revenue for Fin in the luxury goods / watch dealer segment and adjacent industries, from first touch through close and early expansion.

  • Build trust in person through store visits, dealer networks, dinners, and industry conferences.

  • Prospect and develop pipeline through a mix of outbound, warm intros, events, and your own network.

  • Run targeted discovery to uncover payment pain points, accounting workflows, and operational constraints.

  • Demo and position Fin clearly to sharp, no-nonsense operators, then handle objections and keep momentum.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact during onboarding, ensuring customers achieve platform proficiency and understand compliance requirements.

  • Act as a trusted partner and go to resource for customers, following up with customers to promote activity on the platform.

  • Work closely with founders, product, ops, and compliance to turn field feedback into improvements, messaging, and repeatable process.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent and sustained success in closing new accounts in the target market.

  • Building a repeatable field motion that converts skeptical prospects into active customers.

  • Creating a growing pipeline through in-person relationship building and conference execution.

  • Operating as a trusted industry fixture, creating deep relationships to create revenue driving opportunities

Travel and Location

  • Approximately 25-50% travel, especially early on.

  • Preference for candidates near major hubs (for example Miami, New York, Los Angeles, Las Vegas), but open to other locations if you are excited to be on the road and can execute.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of closing experience in sales (SMB to mid-market), partnerships, or an early GTM role with clear ownership of revenue.

  • Comfortable in field sales environments: walking into businesses, earning trust fast, and hearing “no” a lot without losing your edge.

  • Charismatic, personable, and credible with tough, sharp customers who do not tolerate fluff.

  • Strong discovery and deal control: you can diagnose the real problem, keep urgency, and close.

  • High activity, high ownership, self-directed. You build the plan and run it.

  • Willing to work in a competitive environment where speed and execution matter.

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling into watch dealers, jewelers, luxury resale, collectibles, or other high-value, trust-based SMB verticals.

  • Familiarity with crypto and stablecoins, or strong curiosity and the ability to get fluent quickly.

  • Experience selling payments, fintech, FX, or treasury workflows.

title: Marketing Campaigns and Programs Associate
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

We're looking for a highly organized, creative, and results-driven Marketing Campaigns and Programs Associate to help plan, run, and scale the campaigns and growth marketing programs that put Harness in front of developers, platform engineers, and DevOps leaders. In this role, you'll own the day-to-day execution of our webinar program, both Harness-hosted and third-party, from vendor sourcing and speaker management through promotion and results reporting, while also supporting marketing campaigns and additional growth marketing programs as needed.

You'll partner closely with demand generation, content, product marketing, field marketing, and sales to turn great ideas into repeatable, measurable programs. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves operational excellence, and is eager to find creative ways to scale what works.

About the role

  • Own the end-to-end execution of Harness's webinar program, including both hosted webinars and third-party webinars with partners and sponsored-content vendors.
    • Source, evaluate, and manage third-party webinar vendors and partners, including negotiating terms, coordinating deliverables, and tracking lead delivery.
    • Recruit, prep, and coordinate internal and external speakers (customers, partners, Field CTOs, and product experts), managing run-of-show, rehearsals, and day-of logistics.
    • Manage platform setup, registration pages, follow-up nurture, and on-demand content handoff for each webinar.
  • Plan and execute internal and external promotion for every program, including email, social, and paid digital, in partnership with demand gen, content, and creative teams.
    • Build promotion plans and timelines that drive registration and attendance against target audiences and pipeline goals.
    • Coordinate with sales, SDRs, and field marketing to align webinar follow-up with account and pipeline priorities.
  • Report on program results, including registrations, attendance, engagement, pipeline, and cost per outcome, and translate the data into clear recommendations.
  • Bring creative thinking to operationalize and scale demand generation programs, building repeatable playbooks and processes.
  • Support marketing campaigns and additional growth marketing programs.

About you

  • 1–2 years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, campaign management, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience running webinar programs, including hosted and/or third-party webinars, from planning through promotion and follow-up.
  • Experience promoting programs across email, social, and paid digital channels.
  • Experience reporting on program results, with a data-driven approach to measuring performance and informing next steps.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple programs, deadlines, and stakeholders at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate and work cross-functionally with marketing, content, product marketing, sales, and external partners.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment where creativity meets accountability.
  • Creative thinker who finds ways to operationalize and scale demand generation programs through process, automation, and testing.

Nice to have

  • Experience in B2B technology, SaaS, or developer-focused growth marketing.
  • Familiarity with fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with growth marketing programs and campaign management.
  • Interest in AI, DevOps, and software delivery.

Work Location

U.S. Remote

What you will have at Harness

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
  • Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
  • Monthly internet reimbursement

Pay transparency

$79,000—$97,000 USD

Harness in the news:

  • Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
  • Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
  • Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
  • Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Business Development Representative I (m/f/d)
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Business Development Representative I to our Sales team in Munich!

In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of creating new business opportunities and connecting companies with a solution that genuinely impacts their employees’ wellbeing. You will identify and engage prospects through creative outreach, build meaningful relationships with decision-makers, uncover key needs, and confidently articulate the value of Wellhub. Working closely with the Sales organization, you will navigate objections, turn conversations into pipeline, and take end-to-end ownership from initial touchpoint through qualification in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Engage prospective clients and decision-makers through multi-channel outreach, including phone, email, LinkedIn, and creative touchpoints.
  • Partner with the Sales team by transferring qualified opportunities and educating account executives on key discovery details and prospect context.
  • Manage client expectations, navigate objections, and maintain momentum from initial connection to qualified opportunity.
  • Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and pipeline generation targets.
  • Demonstrate the value of Wellhub by articulating the ROI of corporate wellness and educating companies on our mission.
  • Serve as the go-to subject matter expert on target industries and market segments across diverse sectors and geographies.
  • Network proactively with prospective clients and key stakeholders at industry conferences and field events.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A driven sales professional with at least 1+ years of experience in business development, sales, corporate relationship management, or account management.
  • An articulate communicator with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish, capable of engaging internal and external stakeholders effectively.
  • A collaborative team player who thrives on shared success while maintaining tenacity and ownership over individual targets.
  • A strategic problem-solver capable of absorbing data and market insights to build analytically backed outreach strategies.
  • A resilient self-starter with an optimistic mindset, coachable attitude, and adaptability to thrive within the fast-paced shifts of a scale-up organization.
  • A tech-savvy professional with familiarity or hands-on experience using Salesforce CRM and LinkedIn Sales Navigator (a plus).
  • An enthusiast for holistic health who has a strong affinity for sports, fitness, nutrition, and mental wellbeing (a plus).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Sales or Business Development and bilingual communication skills in English and German are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge.

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!


Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!
This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Business Development Representative, Australia
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

This position is 100% remote and will be based in Australia (Sydney/Melbourne).

An overview of this role

GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative to join our growing Go To Market team. As a BDR at GitLab, you will lead the initial outreach to targeted Enterprise and Mid-Market accounts in Australia, working in conjunction with our Field and Digital Marketing teams. In this role you will leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's value proposition. You will be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.

Don't have extensive knowledge about GitLab yet? Don't worry. We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab, and we will provide you with the necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.

What you’ll do

  • Manage inbound lead flow and execute outbound prospecting initiatives.
  • Conduct high-level discovery conversations in target accounts.
  • Meet or exceed BDR sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) volume targets.
  • Collaborate with and leverage teammates to develop targeted lists, call strategies, and messaging to drive opportunities.
  • Use business and industry knowledge to research accounts, identify key players, generate interest, identify compelling events, and develop accounts.
  • Execute a variety of touches (call, email, social, etc.) on all leads in your assigned territory using Outreach.io.
  • Manage, track, and report on all activities and results using Salesforce.
  • Participate in documenting all processes in the GitLab handbook and update as needed with your Sales Development Manager.
  • Collaborate with Field and Corporate Marketing to drive attendance at regional marketing events.
  • Attend field marketing events to engage with participants, identify opportunities, and schedule meetings.
  • Act as a mentor for new BDR hires in helping them navigate their key accounts.
  • Collaborate with Digital Marketing to develop targeted marketing tactics against your assigned target accounts.
  • Share innovative ideas and collaborate with the team to continuously refine BDR strategies and drive measurable results.

What you’ll bring

  • Professional proficiency in English. Proficiency in other Asian languages is a plus.
  • Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, and strong writing skills.
  • A self-starter with a track record of successful, credible achievements.
  • Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.
  • Experience in developing Enterprise and Mid-Market business in Australia
  • Demonstrated persistence in meeting or exceeding targets through consistent follow-up, effective objection handling, and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated interest in GitLab and the DevOps space, such as staying current on GitLab releases or industry trends.
  • Proficient in using Salesforce (incl. Salesforce reporting) and LinkedIn. Proficiency in other prospecting tools (Zoominfo, Cognism, Outreach, 6Sense, etc.) is a plus.
  • Previous tech industry experience; experience in sales development, marketing, and/or sales; and outbound prospecting experience.
  • Be based in Australia (Sydney or Melbourne) and have full working rights in Australia

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

title: Security Analyst - L2
description:
Security Analyst - L2

Location: Remote (United States)
Reporting to: Cybersecurity Operations Leadership

At STN, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.

As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long-term impact.

Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.

Overview
STN is seeking a Security Analyst - L2 to support cybersecurity professional services and managed security operations across customer and internal environments. This hands-on, client-facing position assesses and improves security programs, independently investigates threats, validates technical controls, and develops practical recommendations. Unlike the dedicated Data Center SOC Analyst L2 position, this role spans broader professional-services activities including security assessments, investigations, threat hunting and operational security improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & Incident Response
  • Independently triage and investigate security alerts and incidents for STN and managed-services customers; establish severity, affected assets, supporting evidence and escalation requirements.
  • Correlate endpoint, identity, firewall, network and cloud telemetry using enterprise SIEM/XDR, endpoint security and monitoring capabilities; distinguish real threats from routine operational noise.
  • Investigate suspicious authentication, privilege misuse, malware, lateral movement and potential data exfiltration; coordinate authorized containment while preserving investigation evidence and decisions.
Threat Hunting & Detection Improvement
  • Perform hypothesis-driven threat hunting, develop repeatable detection queries, tune alert logic and document visibility or coverage gaps across customer and internal environments.
  • Participate in cyber wargames, incident-readiness exercises and crisis simulations; assess response workflows, telemetry health and material monitoring blind spots.
Vulnerability Assessment & Security Control Validation
  • Assess operating system, application, identity, cloud configuration and network vulnerabilities; validate technical risk and recommend prioritized remediation.
  • Support deployment, configuration, health checks and validation of endpoint security, log collection, network segmentation, firewall policies and monitoring integrations.
  • Contribute to security control assessments, program reviews, hardening recommendations and evidence collection aligned with applicable frameworks such as NIST 800-53, HIPAA, PCI DSS and FedRAMP.
Customer Consulting & Cross-Functional Delivery
  • Partner with infrastructure, architecture, database and application teams on root-cause analysis, secure design recommendations and verification of corrective actions.
  • Prepare incident timelines, investigation reports, client-facing findings, risk assessments and executive summaries with clearly prioritized next steps.
  • Collaborate with digital forensics and incident response, engineering, automation, implementation and advisory teams to improve security posture and service quality.
Documentation & Mentorship
  • Maintain investigation playbooks, security procedures and knowledge articles; coach L1 analysts on evidence quality, investigation methods and appropriate escalation.

Experience & Qualifications

Required
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, threat detection or security professional services, including independent technical investigations.
  • Demonstrated ability to correlate SIEM/XDR, endpoint, network, identity, Windows and Linux telemetry; working knowledge of TCP/IP, authentication, endpoint behavior and common attacker techniques.
  • Experience investigating suspected compromise, collecting forensic-relevant evidence, coordinating with system owners and preparing clear case records and remediation guidance.
  • Practical experience with vulnerability assessment, secure configuration reviews and technical risk prioritization across infrastructure or applications.
  • Ability to collaborate with client stakeholders and internal security and engineering teams, including occasional after-hours response to high-priority incidents.
  • At least one current intermediate or advanced cybersecurity certification, such as CompTIA CySA+, GIAC GCIH/GCIA, or a comparable recognized blue-team credential.
Preferred
  • Experience in an MSSP, cybersecurity consultancy or other multi-customer environment, including security reviews or compliance-driven engagements.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise SIEM/XDR, EDR, network security, identity security and cloud monitoring capabilities, without requiring expertise in a particular vendor.
  • Ability to script or automate investigative tasks and use security query languages; experience improving detection engineering, threat hunting or response workflows.
Soft Skills
  • Analytical judgment: Evaluate incomplete or conflicting evidence and explain the risk basis for decisions.
  • Customer communication: Translate technical findings into practical recommendations for technical and executive audiences.
  • Ownership and reliability: Independently progress investigations while documenting actions, decisions and handoffs.
  • Collaboration and mentorship: Partner effectively across teams and help improve the quality of L1 investigations.

Compensation

  • Full-Time, Exempt
  • $70,000 - $90,000/year, DOE

Benefits

  • Health Coverage - Medical, Dental & Vision
  • FSA Health and Dependent Care available
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Observed Holidays Paid
  • Cell Phone Allowance
  • Collaborative, growth-driven culture

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and reference verification. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Founder & CEO — Group Buying Agent Protocol
description:
Founder & CEO — Group Buying Agent Protocol

Our AI agents are already saving us money, but they are leaving savings on the table. Build the protocol that lets AI agents pool their users and negotiate as one, starting with insurance.

Location: London

Start date: ASAP

About Founders Factory:

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with Aviva, one of the UK's leading insurers, we are building a new portfolio of ventures out of London.

About the Venture:

People and businesses are starting to hand their buying to AI agents. The share of UK adults who have used or would use an AI agent to shop rose from 31% to 48% in a year. But every agent still shops alone: it gets a quote for one person, one business, one policy at a time.

A careful, low-risk customer looks the same as any other request, and intermediaries take a big cut. Insurance brokers earned about $180bn in fees and commissions worldwide in 2024.

We are building the layer that lets agents buy together. Any agent can enrol its user, with consented and verified data, into cohorts that share a profile: for example small businesses with a clean claims record, or EV owners with a garage and a home charger. Suppliers bid for the cohort in set windows, and each member still gets an individual price.

We start with insurance, where verified data changes the price most, and where the best cohorts can eventually share in their own risk through a profit-share pool or group captive. Then we take the same rails to any category where pooled demand gets a better deal: energy, software, procurement.

The timing is right. The FCA's Mills Review expects AI to act for consumers "within agreed parameters". The Data (Use and Access) Act created powers for smart data schemes, so agents can bring verified facts to every quote. And general-purpose agents are launching at scale.

Jobs to be Done:

As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business.

  • Pick the first market. Decide where group buying works first: SMEs and mid-sized businesses, or consumers through their agents, and which product line to start with.

  • Build the rails. Design the protocol and infrastructure that lets any AI agent enrol users, share verified data with consent and join a cohort.

  • Prove the price. Run the first pilot cohorts with Aviva and show that verified, pooled demand earns a better price than shopping alone.

  • Win the agents. Get agent builders and platforms to plug in, so demand flows to you rather than to comparison sites.

  • Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and extend the rails beyond insurance to any category where buying together wins.

Your Ideal Experience:

You don't need an insurance background. We're looking for an AI-native builder who wants to build the infrastructure the agent economy runs on.

  • Founder or early technical or product leader who has built infrastructure, APIs, protocols or marketplaces.

  • Deep, hands-on fluency with AI agents: you build with them every day and have strong views on where agentic commerce is going.

  • Platform and partnership instinct: you know how to get developers and other platforms to adopt your rails.

  • Exposure to fintech, insurtech, marketplaces or procurement is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: defining a category that doesn't exist yet and making irreversible calls with incomplete data.

  • Credibility with a large corporate partner and with forward-looking venture investors.

Most importantly, you believe agents will soon buy most things for us, and you want to build the layer that makes them buy better.

This is your company. We're here to help.

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly technical and customer-oriented Solutions Consultant to join our growing team.

As a Solutions Consultant, you will sit at the intersection of Sales, Product, Engineering and our customers. You will work with financial institutions to understand complex compliance challenges, design solutions using Dotfile’s platform and AI agents, and turn them into successful production deployments.

You will own the technical customer journey from pre-sales through implementation: leading discovery, designing solution architectures, delivering compelling demonstrations and proofs of concept, and guiding customers through integration and go-live. As Dotfile moves toward increasingly autonomous compliance, you will help customers rethink manual processes, identify opportunities for automation, and deploy our AI capabilities into real-world compliance workflows.

We believe AI should transform not only our product, but also how we work. You will be expected to use AI extensively to work faster, automate repetitive tasks, improve customer delivery, and help us build a more scalable Solutions Consulting organization.

You will report directly to the Director of Solutions Consulting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales process, partnering with Sales to understand customer challenges and design solutions that address them

  • Lead technical discovery with prospects to understand their compliance workflows, technical architecture, data sources and integration requirements

  • Design and deliver tailored product demonstrations and proofs of concept that show how Dotfile can solve complex, real-world compliance challenges

  • Architect end-to-end solutions using Dotfile’s platform, APIs, integrations and AI capabilities, and clearly communicate them to both technical and business stakeholders

  • Own the technical success of customer implementations, from solution design and configuration through integration, testing and go-live

  • Help customers identify opportunities to automate manual compliance processes and deploy Dotfile’s AI capabilities into production workflows

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering, bringing customer insights into product decisions and helping shape what we build next

  • Use AI extensively in your own work to automate repetitive tasks, accelerate solution design and documentation, and continuously improve how the Solutions Consulting team operates

About you

  • You have 3+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, or another technical customer-facing role, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech or RegTech

  • You are technically strong and comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows and modern integration architectures

  • You can quickly understand complex business processes and translate them into clear technical solutions and automation opportunities

  • You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, redesigning workflows with operations teams, and presenting solutions to senior executives

  • You are excited about AI and already use AI tools extensively in your work. You naturally look for opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve how things are done

  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment with high standards and strong ownership. You can manage several opportunities and implementations in parallel

  • Experience in financial services, compliance or RegTech is a plus, but not required

  • You are fluent in English and French

The interview process

  • Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

  • Round 2: Two-part discussion where you'll walk us through your career journey and the choices that shaped it, followed by a values-based interview.

  • Round 3: Deep dive into one of your key projects with someone from a different team, offering a fresh, cross-functional perspective on how you work.

  • Round 4: Practical exercise, case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

  • Round 5: Final conversation with our founder.

title: Strategist, Agent Development (Dutch speaking)
description:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

What you'll do

As an Agent Strategist, you own how Sierra's AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer's thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business.

  • Own the Agent Development Life Cycle. Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it's the best version of itself in the real world. You'll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome.

  • Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers' executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there.

  • Partner with the customer's working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch.

  • Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next.

Example projects

These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently:

  • Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers.

  • Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation.

  • Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples.

  • Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner.

  • Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week.

What you'll bring

  • Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships.

  • Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast.

  • Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion.

  • Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes.

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

  • You've been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.

Our values

  • Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

  • Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

  • Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

  • Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at ----- Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMastâ¢ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing networkâcombining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Quality Engineer to strengthen our quality systems and support rising production volumes across Quartermasterâs SmartMastâ¢ systems and related marine products. This role will help us reduce defects and field returns, lead structured root-cause investigations, and keep our hardware manufacturing and deployment operations audit-ready as we scale globally. The right candidate has strong hands-on experience building practical quality management processes for electromechanical hardware in demanding environments, and can partner effectively across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturers to catch issues early and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and scale our Quality Management System (QMS), standard operating procedures, and inspection protocols to ensure continuous audit readiness (e.g., ISO 9001 / AS9100 standards).

  • Lead structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) investigations (8D, 5-Whys, Fishbone) for manufacturing non-conformances, test failures, and field/customer returns.

  • Partner with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers during New Product Introduction (NPI) to establish Design for Quality (DFQ), PFMEA, control plans, and incoming/in-process/final acceptance test criteria.

  • Track, analyze, and report key quality metrics (yield, defect rates, RMA/field return trends, supplier performance) to drive measurable reductions in defects and hardware rework.

  • Collaborate with contract manufacturers and component suppliers on First Article Inspections (FAI), supplier audits, non-conforming material review (MRB), and corrective action follow-through.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Bachelorâs degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Quality Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3â5+ years of experience in quality engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

  • Strong command of root-cause analysis and quality tools (CAPA, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and First Article Inspection).

  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers to qualify parts, resolve production defects, and enforce quality standards.

  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or AS9100 quality frameworks and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across remote engineering teams, field operations, and manufacturing partners.

  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Six Sigma certification is a plus.

Work Environment:

  • Flexible working hours, with occasional intensive sprints aligned to production milestones and audits.

  • Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, suppliers, or field deployment sites.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customerâs broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read thisÂ blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
